summary.text: Jim Jonas is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 13 since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jonas earned a B.S. in social science from Minot State University, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as a teacher and coach at West Fargo High School, and he has been affiliated with the West Fargo Public School Board, the West Fargo Education Foundation and the West Fargo Exchange Club.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Education Committee and the House Political Subdivisions Committee.
